Chapter 486: Chapter 20: Where Is Everyone? (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 486: Chapter 20: Where is Everyone? (Please Subscribe)

Outside the passage.

Chaotic Celestial King and many other Supreme Immortal Kings were stunned.

Initially, they thought that after Martial Ancestor defeated the opponent on the First Layer with one move, he would need to engage in a tough struggle against the subsequent layers’ opponents.

But unexpectedly, for Martial Ancestor, the opponent on the First Layer was just the beginning.

Second Layer, Third Layer… all opponents were defeated with a single move.

How was this possible?

...

Could it be that the strength of the opponents in the First, Second, and Third Layers were all the same?

Many Immortal Kings thought it through and realized it was impossible.

The only possibility was that Martial Ancestor was too strong.

Just like how Chaotic Celestial King, a Supreme Immortal King, could resolve any Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King with one move, whether they were just beginning or at their peak.

“My god, that is the Dragon Ancestor, the True Dragon Progenitor of the Spirit Realm, born at the dawn of the Spirit Realm, vanished before the endless ages.”

A Supreme Immortal King saw that Martial Ancestor’s opponent on the Seventh Layer was a million-zhang long True Dragon, its dragon horns golden, exuding a noble aura.

The True Dragon Progenitor, as the ancestral origin of all in the Spirit Realm with True Dragon Bloodline, it was said the Dragon Ancestor intended to merge his own bloodline into all beings’ bodies.

Thus, even though countless millennia had passed since the Dragon Ancestor vanished, the True Dragon Bloodline still lingered.

In the Jiujang Domain of the Three Thousand Dao Provinces, a ‘Dragon Rising Site’ once bore a Tribulation-Transcending Dragon King.

Of course, that Dragon King was no match for the True Dragon Progenitor; the former, upon facing the latter, didn’t even need to make a move, being completely suppressed by the innate differential in their bloodlines.

The Dragon Ancestor was too famous, its bloodline lingering in the Spirit Realm without vanishing into history, so many Supreme Immortal Kings recognized it at first glance.

In fact, the power of Dragon Ancestor was indeed terrifying, situated on the Seventh Layer at the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

That is, in the Spirit Realm’s judgment, the Dragon Ancestor was ranked the fourth strongest life form since the creation of the Spirit Realm.

However, in front of Lin Yuan, even the formidable True Dragon Progenitor was merely punched through, his Dragon body pierced, the residual force of the punch shattering his remaining body.

The many Immortal Kings fell silent.

Chaotic Celestial King’s gaze was empty.

“That is the Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor… Unexpectedly, the Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor is even stronger than the Dragon Ancestor, located on the Third Layer…”

By the time Lin Yuan reached the Eighth Layer, the many Supreme Immortal Kings revived their spirits, looking towards this layer’s opponent, starting to discuss amongst themselves.

The Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor was similar to the True Dragon Progenitor, both powerful lives born at the inception of the Spirit Realm, and the Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor also infused its bloodline into other beings.

In many places across the Three Thousand Dao Provinces, numerous phoenix nests fostered lives bearing the phoenix bloodline.

Although the Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor sparked a lot of discussion among the Supreme Immortal Kings, remembering the fate of the True Dragon Progenitor made everyone sigh internally.

Sure enough.

Facing the formidable Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor, Lin Yuan threw out another punch, tore through the Phoenix body, and entered the Ninth Layer.

Soon.

He entered the Tenth Layer.

Up to this layer, all the Supreme Immortal Kings, including Chaotic Celestial King now doubting himself, were suddenly shocked.

The Tenth Layer.

The final layer on the pathway to the Ninth Heaven.

Also, the layer where the life stamps of the strongest beings since the birth of the Spirit Realm are located.

To pass this layer, one must defeat the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s inception.

How high is this difficulty?

This isn’t just a strongest life form of an era, not merely of an age.

But the strongest life from since the inception of the Spirit Realm?

One might guess, the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s birth must have an enormous gap compared to the second and third strongest beings.

“Who knows what the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s birth actually looks like?”

Many Supreme Immortal Kings focused intently on the Tenth Layer, also conversing.

“Could it be from my Human Race?”

“Probably not, look at the Seventh, Eighth, and Ninth Layers, those life forms aren’t from the Human Race. Compared to naturally powerful beings like the Dragon Clan and Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor, our Human Race doesn’t hold any advantage.”

Supreme Immortal Kings shared their views.

If not for the passage of eras, those with powerful ancestral bloodlines vanishing from sight, the rulers of recent eras really might not have been Immortal Kings from the Human Race.

“Probably like the Dragon Clan and Phoenix Clan, a powerful life born at the dawn of the world…”

An Immortal King spoke, causing other Immortal Kings to nod in agreement.

As all the Supreme Immortal Kings were conversing.

From the deep mists of the Tenth Layer’s entrance, a figure emerged.

This figure was humanoid, its sleeves fluttering, merely standing there, it exuded an immensely terrifying aura, its life force enveloping the Three Thousand Dao Provinces.

“Martial Ancestor… is this Martial Ancestor?”

“The life stamp on the Tenth Layer, is actually Martial Ancestor?”

“Martial Ancestor is… the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s birth?”

The scene exploded with chatter from the many Supreme Immortal Kings.

Being the strongest life form since the inception of the Spirit Realm was such a lofty accolade that they had never considered that this strongest being might be Martial Ancestor, who existed in the same era as them.

“Indeed, easily piercing through the previous nine opponents, Martial Ancestor…”

Chaotic Celestial King murmured to himself.

The previous nine opponents were no match for a single punch from Martial Ancestor.

If not Martial Ancestor, then who would be the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s inception?

“The strongest life form since the birth of the Spirit Realm… I never imagined I would have the honor of witnessing such a powerhouse.”

“Yes, surpassing Dragon Ancestor and Heavenly Phoenix Ancestor, Martial Ancestor is just too abnormal.”

The Supreme Immortal Kings were greatly moved.

But subsequently.

The many Supreme Immortal Kings then realized.

Martial Ancestor was the strongest life form since the Spirit Realm’s inception, possessing the unquestionable greatest combat power.
